posts.t:
Thanks romant & Lehmann.

romant, the horizontal line is at 1.0310 and the rejection IPB at a nice location but look at HTF next chart the H4....you see the S/R flip and where is price coming from? actually I should've let it run instead of closing it where i did, but anyway that was my plan.

Now, you see the next candle didn't close above the rejection candle and if it did, price would've pulled back to the white line where i should start worrying if it goes higher.

My personal problem is not fear, it's greed! However you can control your fear by risking small lots, and by time your confidence will kick in and you'll increase the lot size, then your ego will take over your logical thinking, and if you ever get a margin call then fear will take over and you'll have to start the whole process again.

If you have a plan before taking a trade then there is no place for fear.
posts.fa:

romant، خط افقی روی 1.0310 است و IPB ریجکشن هم در نقطهٔ خوبی قرار دارد، اما چارت بعدی را در HTF ببین، یعنی H4… فلیپ S/R را می‌بینی و اینکه قیمت از کجا می‌آید؟ راستش باید می‌گذاشتم کارش را بکند و آن‌جا که بستم نمی‌بستم، ولی به‌هرحال پلنم همین بود.
